scope: Independent visual inspection of eight regenerated native production PNG proofs at original resolution after correcting text-shadow compositing. PASS applies only to these stills and inspected layout/effect states; no movie, acoustic-sync or complete sequence claim.

observations: Landscape proofs retain native 1920×818 canvas without added letterbox bands.
Portrait source picture remains panoramic and uncropped above the lyric area, with same-scene blurred fill.
Text is fully readable and contained; spectrum columns, caps and reflection remain separated from lyrics.
Corrected hurts treatment retains all letter shapes with restrained interior cracks.
Ending card has no lingering captions, spectrum or added shading.
Source-dark still at209.433333s falls inside independently recorded source-black interval209.416667–209.458333s; neutral pre-roll words remain visible.
Corrected Supernova proof shows a gentle purple aura; light/you beam landing, freezing ice fill, darkness shadow and restrained hurts cracks remain clear.

findings.observation: The Supernova word lacks the expected visible purple halo; all text-shadow layers use an off-canvas drawImage displacement.
findings.conclusion: Native canvas culls the off-canvas body and its shadow. This removes glow and readability-shadow layers despite correct word fills.
findings.requiredCorrection: Render shadows on an on-canvas intermediate mask/layer, composite them at the intended word coordinates, then draw the glyph body once. Regenerate affected proofs.
findings.correction: Replaced displaced off-canvas drawImage shadows with on-canvas tinted alpha masks, Gaussian blur and one glyph-body composite.
findings.verification: All eight proofs were regenerated and visually re-inspected. Supernova now has the intended gentle purple halo; other text shadows are visible without glyph motion, fill duplication, clipping or reduced legibility.

limits: Stills establish layout and the visible state at inspected times only. Parent is reviewing encoded motion and final-delivery verification separately.
